seven_research_axes.name: Local observer boost versus global tilt

node_reading: The canonical_state is the verbatim R78 state. Direct evidence includes recorded source diagnostics, theory, transfer tests or acquisition plans as labeled in reviewed_results. Each retained physical acceptance still requires its own inputs.
cross_route_scope: Bounds computed from the R78 stored summaries and its two synthetic closure witnesses. All ranks, errors and bounds condition on the recorded frame, norm, windows and inputs.

PHY-01.source: original CF4 table4 38053 full groups, conditional subset 40-400 Mpc; NOT identical to R61 35970 selected

CF4_SHARED_FIELD_HOLDOUT.json.scope: Shared-field and fresh-prior predictions on 8,885 6dFGSv release rows with two group linkages.

GAIA_FRAME_RESULT.json.scope: Four-shell VSH curvature and exact patch deletion influence on cached 634,233 Gaia/Quaia rows.

RADIO_COVARIANCE_RESULT.json.scope: Sharp additional covariance budget on 241,892 shared NVSS components under paired Poisson influence.

SIGNED_REFERENCE.json.scope: Signed collision and matched test-photon IX blocks; separate AniCLASS output convention. Full all-family matched transfer remains open.

CLOSED_TENSOR_HISTORY.json.scope: Closed regular IX m=2 photon evolution on supplied AniCLASS metric and opacity; matched signed T/E/B at five times and four resolutions.

P1_PATTERN_RESULT.json.scope: Actual joint-window counts on the original 2,048 apparent-CF4 draws and sharp integer bounds from compressed marginals.

COMMANDER_PAIR_REPLAY.json.scope: One PR3 Commander signal/noise pair, six raw pseudo-spectra. Beam, foreground adequacy and the ensemble null remain open.

COMMANDER_ENSEMBLE_PLAN.json.scope: Existing size candidates and additional required bytes for 300 pairs. This plan does not execute an ensemble.

PV_FIELD_PLAN.json.scope: Geometry joined for all 35,970 CF4 groups at 198,924 grid vertices. Manticore field host timed out; zero posterior fields and no physical S_PV computed.

NATIVE_RESULT.json.scope: Cold moving Thomson in the coupled cell step, stiffness-1000 residual and fixed-fiducial family sweeps.

MASSLESS_NEUTRINO_RESULT.json.scope: Separate massless neutrino hierarchy with photon-only drag and joint stress feedback at fixed total radiation density. Independent observational flux remains open.

HIGH_TILT_QUADRATURE.json.scope: At |beta|=0.90554, four-force on one fixed all-Stokes sky reaches relative error 5.26e-10 with 32 angular rings.

REC_REI_RESULT.json.scope: Class B density and baryon-clock controls, positive optical interpolation and visibility closure in REC/REI.

REI_SOURCE_RESULT.json.scope: Published 1001-row H/He scenario passed to opacity; finite depth from z=20 to z=4 with named observer and material history.

REI_FIVE_CASE_OPTICAL.json.scope: Conditional even/odd depth comparison across five signed prescribed homogeneous shear histories with 1001 rows each.
